compatibility: Omit the entire contract key unless this connection negotiated the capability. Existing rank fields and legacy packets are unchanged.

identity.name: nonempty string, authoritative server skill name
identity.profession: int32 0..5, 1-based profession identity; 0 for a granted non-profession skill
identity.unlockLevel: int32 >= 0, original learning identity, not effective rank
identity.prerequisiteSkillIds: array of distinct positive int32 IDs; hard learning prerequisites
identity.current: payload or null when no effective learned/granted rank is available
identity.next: payload or null when no representable next-rank preview exists

payload.mpCost: int32 >= 0, actual resolved skill MP cost after training, native passive and equipped modifiers
payload.prepareMs: int32 >= 0, resolved preparation including a non-consuming preview of current one-shot cast-reduction status
payload.cooldownMs: int32 >= 0, resolved skill cooldown, not remaining cooldown
payload.castDistance: int32 >= 0 in world units; 0 means no additional server distance bound, never substitute a default
payload.usable: boolean, active skill has a closed server effect; does NOT assert MP, cooldown, riding, silence or target validation
payload.requiredWeaponType: int32 >= 0; original weapon requirement, 0 means none
payload.inputMode: none | self | entity | point | direction | trapEntity
payload.pointRequired: boolean, explicit point required by the server (point teleport)
payload.selfFallback: boolean, omitted selection may use caster position/entity under the actual server resolver
payload.targetEnemy: boolean, hostile monsters; does not authorize player-vs-player damage
payload.targetTeam: boolean, SAME PARTY ONLY, never arbitrary friendly players
payload.allowsDeadTarget: boolean, server resurrection semantics allow a dead same-party player
payload.deadTargetOnly: boolean, pure resurrection rejects living targets
payload.groundEffect: boolean, actual server positional effect flag

area.angle: int32 >= 0, full cone angle in degrees

semantics: Identity is supplied for every available profession row, including unlearned skills and skills absent from local resource JSON.
Existing hardRank/grantRank/effectiveRank/CanCast define learning and grant availability. A current-null row must not borrow next MP cost for real admission.
The input resolver uses structured effects and area rules, never localized description parsing. Trap/reveal/detect geometry comes from the actual special-effect fields consumed by the server.
trapEntity is the visible, non-owned trap entity ID sent through the existing UseSkill target ID; the server validates trap visibility/ownership/range.
A snapshot may become stale. The server remains final authority; missing/stale typed data must not trigger a hard rejection based on stale external-resource MP costs.
The field set changes no original curves, learned-point cap, equipment rank rules, training synergies, historical effects or tooltip layout.
